capabilities: Embed interactive Structurizr views in notes using Markdown image syntax
Export workspaces locally with the Structurizr CLI and serve them from a localhost-only server
Watch DSL and JSON workspace files and re-export on changes
Adjust each diagram's height, zoom, fit, and fullscreen, and open views in Structurizr local
Preserve manual layout positions from workspace JSON when re-exporting changed DSL
disambiguation: Not a general diagram editor or drawing tool; it only renders views from existing Structurizr DSL or JSON workspace files via the CLI.
extras: Desktop-only. Runs fully locally: it strips the remote theme loader so workspace data stays on the machine and the server binds only to 127.0.0.1. Static export drops documentation and decision records, and a Git revision viewer is not yet implemented. Includes an example vault.
problem: Obsidian cannot render Structurizr workspace views inside notes, and Structurizr local does not support iframe or image embeds.

relations.evidence: Install the Structurizr CLI and Graphviz.
Graphviz supplies automatic layout for DSL views that use autoLayout.
an action to open the view in Structurizr local

summary: Embeds interactive Structurizr architecture diagrams in notes by exporting local DSL or JSON workspaces with the Structurizr CLI.
